svg.aria-label: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with PKCE: the app sends the user to the authorization server, the user logs in and consents, the app receives a one-time code, exchanges it with the code verifier for an access token, and calls the API with that token.

svg.text: access token (+ refresh token, ID token)
